summary: Deliver a small trustworthy kernel library whose performance claims can be reproduced and whose unsupported cases are clear.
outcomes: Specify, implement and package several kernels with numerical and API contracts.
Defend performance choices using baselines, traces and held-out inputs.
sequence: Choose a bounded transform, reduction and matrix operation with explicit contracts.
Build CPU/library references and adversarial tests.
Implement simple correct versions before optimization.
Use profiling to select improvements and dispatch choices.
Package, document and reproduce the result on stated hardware.

visual.question: Which optimization improved useful work without breaking the contract?
visual.interaction: Compare correctness cases, resource traces and runtime distributions for each version.

practice.task: Deliver source, fixtures, tests, environment lock, benchmark artifacts and a design note.
practice.success: A fresh documented environment reproduces correctness; performance claims identify inputs, baselines and limitations.
